Displaced Persons (Forfeiture Of Payment) Rules 1962
Displaced Persons (Forfeiture Of Payment) Rules
1962
[Gazette of Pakistan,
19th October 1962]
S. R. O. 1123 (K)/62.-In exercise of the powers
conferred by section 35 of the Displaced Persons (Compensation and
Rehabilitation) Act, 1958 (XXVIII of 1958), the Central Government is pleased
to make the following rules, namely :‑--
1. These rules may be called the
Displaced Persons (Forfeiture of Payment) Rules, 1962.
2. (1) Where any person is
ejected under sub-paragraph (1) of para graph 24 of the Schedule to the
Displaced Persons (Compensation and Rehabilitation) Act, 1958 (XXVIII of 1958),
and the transaction relating to the property transferred to him is cancelled
under sub-paragraph (3) of that paragraph, the person concerned shall forfeit
such part of the amount paid by him, not exceeding twenty-five per cent.,
thereof, as the Chief Settlement Commissioner may in each case determine.
(2) The amount so forfeited may
be deducted from the amount payable to the person concerned as compensation or
from any sum paid by him as price of the property transferred to him or partly
from both.
(3) The amount so forfeited shall
remain a part of compensa tion pool.
F. 9
